name: contest6_group_split_v1
description: Duplicate-group split of the official 200_train_cases for a CLEAN RETRAIN. test is sealed (score once per frozen system); dev is for model selection; train is everything else. Every image in a test/dev group, from any source, must be removed from training (see forbidden manifest). Models trained on the current detector datasets are contaminated on this split; flags per case say how.

rules.exact_pixels: identical decoded RGB (sha256 over WxH:RGB: + pixels)
rules.perceptual: pHash <= T AND dHash <= T (64-bit, grayscale cropped to ink bbox); T = 12, or 8 when either image is an HF open_schematics sheet
rules.label_jaccard: official cases only: multiset Jaccard of non-∅ (key, value) >= 0.55, both with >= 25 non-∅ components
rules.lab_variant_name: component_lab files <base>_v<k> in the same folder

gt10_policy: every group containing a 10_GTcase image is train (GT10 duplicates train200; format smoke test only)
test_priority: within each tag, groups never in any detector train/val folder first, then val-only, then train
